Address every blocker/major finding below on the SAME branch, then send a new finish report so review re-runs.\n- [major] agent-orchestration/topology/lib/reviewer.mjs:1004 — The idle check will fail a verdict that is still printing for a Claude reviewer, which is the default provider, reintroducing the bug TM-215 review 2 fixed. Claude Code keeps its empty input box on screen while a turn is streaming, so the composer-empty pattern matches during generation. The check also runs over the whole 5000-line capture with the m flag, so any empty prompt line left in scrollback counts as idle too. FIX: Do not treat composer-empty as idle for providers whose input box is shown while busy. Rely on the time bound, or on an unchanged capture across two ticks, or require both an empty composer below the verdict and no busy indicator from the adapter. At minimum, test only the lines after the verdict. Add a Claude-shaped test where a partial verdict sits above an empty input box and is not failed.\n- [major] .bytedesk/task-management/evidence/TM-217.unit-tests.txt:1 — The patch commits three check-output files (a 4456-line TAP log, the build-check and the plugin-validate output) under .bytedesk/task-management/evidence/. They are outside the declared touches, and that directory is one of the TM-224 tool store paths, so manage integrate will refuse this landing with TOPOLOGY_MANAGEMENT_STORE_PATHS. FIX: Drop the three evidence files from the task branch, and attach check output through tm evidence in the main checkout rather than as a commit."},{"author":"worker:tmux","ts":"2026-09-25T17:53:04.387Z","text":"tmux worker exited after submitting its revision; Follow-up from Faro's TM-215 round-3 approval (minor, reviewer.mjs ~971). collectReview throws TOPOLOGY_REVIEWER_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE for an unclosed verdict; that code never fails the request, and collectPendingReviews only fails when delivery.rang is false. A reviewer that ends with a truncated line is retried forever with no lead escalation. Fix: record first-incomplete time; if still INCOMPLETE after a bound (or the pane is idle at its prompt), mark the request failed and escalate like a refusal.
